description: Capture SAY/SPEAK utterance tokens after existing SEND normalization but before noun parsing, and split natural question/exclamation punctuation cleanly

replacements.old:
<SETG P-LEN <GETB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS>>
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,P-LEN 6>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SEND>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 2 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?AFTER>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 4 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?WITH>>
		   <SETG P-LEN 4>
		   <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 4>)>
	<COND (<ZERO? ,P-LEN> <TELL "I beg your pardon?" CR> <RFALSE>)>
replacements.new:
<SETG P-LEN <GETB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS>>
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,P-LEN 6>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SEND>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 2 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?AFTER>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 4 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?WITH>>
		   <SETG P-LEN 4>
		   <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 4>)>
	<COND (<AND <G? ,P-LEN 1>
		    <OR <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV .PTR> ,W?SAY>
			<EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV .PTR> ,W?SPEAK>>>
	       <SETG P-SPOKEN-PTR <+ .PTR ,P-LEXELEN>>
	       <SETG P-SPOKEN-COUNT <- ,P-LEN 1>>
	       <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 1>
	       <SETG P-LEN 1>)>
	<COND (<ZERO? ,P-LEN> <TELL "I beg your pardon?" CR> <RFALSE>)>
